title: We Should All Be Feminists
author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
summary: Adapted from a talk, this short essay draws on Adichie's life in Nigeria and abroad to explain why she calls herself a feminist and how everyday expectations shape girls and boys.
readIf: you want a brief, clear and personal introduction to feminist ideas.
skipIf: you are looking for a deep academic study of gender with data and theory.
